security.journey.providerTestDescription: Test the configured identity provider with your administrator identity. Successful completion records readiness for this configuration.
security.preview.identity.title: Authentication methods preview
security.preview.identity.description: Inspect the planned entry states using generated contract fixtures.
security.preview.simulated: Development preview · Simulated data; no sign-in or policy change occurs.
security.preview.error.ownerUnavailable: The identity service is temporarily unavailable in this fixture.
security.preview.error.generic: This simulated request could not be completed.
security.preview.error.stale: The policy changed. A live journey would refresh before continuing.
security.preview.error.assurance: More assurance is required. This preview cannot satisfy a challenge.
security.preview.error.region: The owning region changed. A live journey would follow its signed correction.
security.preview.error.provider: The provider is unavailable. This preview does not start external sign-in.
security.preview.empty: No method is available in this fixture. A live journey would stop here.
security.preview.identity.screen.entry.d: Combined entry and privacy-preserving method availability.
security.preview.identity.screen.account: Choose an identity for this product tab without changing other tabs.
Signup and profile capture continue through the existing CSI flow.
security.preview.identity.screen.verific: A link preview is separate from consuming a verification token.
security.preview.identity.screen.organiz: Organization classification and completion remain CSI-owned.
security.preview.identity.screen.recover: Recovery requests use the same public response for every address.
security.preview.identity.screen.finaliz: Destination finalization uses a signed, tab-bound continuation.
security.preview.identity.screen.safeErr: Expired or invalid requests return safely to a fresh product entry.
security.preview.identity.privacy: Availability is flow-scoped. It does not reveal whether an entered account exists.
security.preview.identity.noAccounts: No signed-in account is available in this fixture.
security.preview.identity.noResult: There is no eligible continuation in this fixture. A live journey would stop safely.
security.preview.identity.chooseAccount: Choose an account for this product tab:
security.preview.identity.unavailableAcc: Another account could not be checked; retry before using it.
security.preview.identity.perTab: This selection is local to this preview tab and does not issue a product session.
security.preview.identity.progress.check: Check the email address to continue signup.
security.preview.identity.progress.organ: Complete the organization details in the CSI continuation.
security.preview.identity.verificationFo: Verification link preview for {{email}}. No token was consumed.
security.preview.identity.recoveryAccept: If the address is eligible, recovery instructions will arrive by email.
security.preview.identity.finalizationPe: The signed destination continuation would finalize the product return.
security.preview.identity.safeRestart: The request cannot continue. Start a fresh authentication request from the product.
security.preview.identity.selectionOnly: Preview selection only. No identity or product session was created.
security.preview.state.empty: The fixture has no eligible result.
security.preview.state.partial: Only verified partial information is shown.
security.preview.state.read-only: Actions are unavailable in this state.
security.preview.state.async-progress: The action is still pending; no success is assumed.
security.preview.ceremony.screen.passkey: A server challenge is required before any browser credential operation.
security.preview.ceremony.screen.totp.de: Manual setup and code entry remain bound to one ceremony.
security.preview.ceremony.screen.recover: A single-use code is checked by the identity home.
Step-up binds the method to an exact operation, target, and session revision.
security.preview.ceremony.screen.factorR: Approval, holding period, repudiation, and terminal status remain server-owned.
security.preview.ceremony.empty: No eligible ceremony is available. Start again from the product.
security.preview.ceremony.passkeyChallen: A typed passkey challenge is available. This preview cannot use a browser credential or verify it.
security.preview.ceremony.browserUnavail: No browser credential was requested or verified in this preview.
security.preview.ceremony.totpPrompt: Use an authenticator app, or reveal the manual setup key once. No QR code is required.
security.preview.ceremony.materialUnavai: Setup material has already been displayed and cannot be shown again.
security.preview.ceremony.recoveryCodePr: Enter a recovery code. The preview always rejects it without consuming a real code.
security.preview.ceremony.serverContinua: The server returned a further ceremony step; no authentication was completed here.
security.preview.ceremony.stepUpPending: The action remains pending until the exact factor challenge is verified. No action proof is issued in preview.
security.preview.ceremony.firstLogin: First-login enrollment and grace are separate from confirming a protected action.
Recovery was requested; no factor has changed.
Recovery is awaiting an authorized decision.
Recovery is approved but has not completed.
Recovery is in its required holding period.
Recovery is ready for the required completion ceremony.
Recovery completed in the authoritative service.
The recovery request expired. Start a new request.
The recovery request was repudiated and cannot continue.
security.preview.ceremony.hold: Completion remains unavailable until the holding period ends.
security.preview.ceremony.error.expired: The challenge expired. Restart the ceremony; it cannot be resumed.
security.preview.ceremony.error.replayed: The ceremony revision or one-time proof is no longer valid. Restart safely.
security.preview.federation.screen.feder: SAML and OIDC starts, callbacks, and IdP handoff remain bound to the exact identity ceremony.
security.preview.federation.screen.emerg: An emergency route requires an assigned identity, local factor, alert readiness, and review.
security.preview.federation.screen.jitPr: Federated identity and primary-email verification precede profile completion.
security.preview.federation.screen.scimA: A human verifies primary email and activates an identity before any separate access invitation.
security.preview.federation.empty: No eligible provider or activation continuation is available.
security.preview.federation.configured: {{protocol}} start is configured for this fixture flow.
security.preview.federation.noRedirect: Configuration is not a successful runtime sign-in. This preview never follows the provider URL or consumes a callback proof.
security.preview.federation.handoff: IdP handoff would present {{tenant}} through {{provider}} after server redemption.
security.preview.federation.continuation: The typed continuation requests {{step}}. No account or session was established in preview.
security.preview.federation.ssoOnly: Password entry is unavailable on this SSO-only route.
security.preview.federation.emergency: An emergency request may be accepted, but activation remains gated by a local factor and independent alert test.
security.preview.federation.jitEmail: Verify the primary email before completing a provisional profile.
security.preview.federation.jitProfile: Profile completion is an explicit next ceremony step; federation alone does not finish it.
security.preview.federation.jitProfileSa: Typed profile proposal: first name {{firstName}}, tenant handle {{handle}}, avatar fallback {{avatarColor}}. The owner must validate the handle and profile before completion.
security.preview.federation.privacyHando: If this purpose and policy version requires acknowledgement, the privacy owner must supply a verified receipt handoff. This fixture has none and submits no profile.
security.preview.federation.pictureImpor: An external picture is never fetched directly in this preview. Live import requires a controlled, validated server path.
security.preview.federation.scimVerify: The provisioned person's primary email must be verified by that person.
security.preview.federation.scimActivate: Identity activation is ready in this fixture; target access is separate.
security.preview.federation.scimPending: Identity activation remains pending further verification.
security.preview.federation.noAccessGran: Activation does not grant tenant or product access. The authorization owner must supply a separate invitation.
security.preview.federation.providerOuta: The provider is unavailable. Configuration alone does not prove runtime readiness.
security.preview.recipient.title: Invitation inbox preview
security.preview.recipient.description: Review account-bound offers and the separate authorization decision journey using generated recipient contract fixtures.
security.preview.recipient.empty.pending: No pending offers are visible for this selected account.
security.preview.recipient.empty.history: No recipient decision history is visible for this selected account.
security.preview.recipient.backfill: Recipient routing is still reconciling. Some offers may be delayed.
security.preview.recipient.teaser: An invitation needs its original emailed link before details can be shown.
security.preview.recipient.teaserPrivacy: This teaser contains no inviter, tenant, target, invitation ID, or access grant.
security.preview.recipient.claimed: The simulated email link carries an invitation ID, version, and complete token. Offer details remain hidden until the authoritative decision completes.
security.preview.recipient.tokenMemory: The complete emailed token stays in memory for the decision and is never placed in a URL or saved here.
security.preview.recipient.state.pending: Pending offer. No access has been granted.
security.preview.recipient.state.accepte: Acceptance is provisioning; access is not ready yet.
security.preview.recipient.state.revoked: This offer is no longer available.
security.preview.recipient.state.failed: This offer failed and needs a new authorized action.
security.preview.recipient.uncertain: The offer status is uncertain. Decisions remain disabled until the owner reconciles it.
security.preview.recipient.skipped: Skipped locally. The invitation remains available on other devices.
security.preview.recipient.queued.accept: Acceptance was queued. It is not an access grant until the tenant-home receipt completes.
security.preview.recipient.queued.reject: Rejection was queued. It becomes terminal only after the tenant-home receipt completes.
security.preview.recipient.operation.pen: The decision is pending at the owning region.
security.preview.recipient.operation.com: The owning region confirmed the decision.
security.preview.recipient.operation.fai: The decision failed. A new authorized intent is needed.
security.preview.recipient.completedDeta: Completed item is read-only. State: {{state}}. Reason: {{reason}}.
security.preview.recipient.error.stale: The invitation or page snapshot changed. Refresh before deciding.
security.preview.recipient.error.route: The owning region changed. A live journey would follow its signed correction.
security.preview.recipient.error.capabil: The account-bound recipient capability expired. Refresh under the selected account.
security.preview.recipient.error.token: The complete original emailed token is required for an unpinned offer.
security.preview.recipient.error.denied: This selected account cannot act on that offer.
security.preview.recipient.error.unavail: The recipient authority is unavailable in this fixture.
security.journey.expired: This sign-in choice expired. Start again.
security.journey.emailDescription: Choose and independently verify your primary email. A provider email is not primary-email verification.
security.journey.profile: Complete your profile before account admission.
security.journey.picture: Your avatar uses initials and color. Provider picture URLs are never loaded directly.
security.journey.privacy: I acknowledge the current privacy notice
security.journey.privacyOptional: I consent to the optional use described in the current privacy notice
security.journey.factor: An additional controlled factor is required.
security.journey.collision: This identity needs explicit resolution. Sign in to the existing account and authorize linking; email alone cannot link accounts.
security.journey.invitations: Review pending invitations. Signing in does not accept an offer.
security.journey.noGrant: The decision is pending. Target access has not been confirmed.
security.journey.ready: Identity completion is ready for the account continuation.
security.journey.noSession: This development journey cannot establish an account or product session.
security.journey.rejected: This sign-in was rejected. Start a new flow.
security.journey.retry: The operation did not complete. Retry the same input or cancel and start again.
security.journey.cancelFailed: Cancellation has not been confirmed. Try again.
security.journey.demoRedirect: A real start would navigate to the admitted provider. This development fixture stays here.

emergency.description: For a designated administrator during an SSO outage. Fresh local MFA and a reason are required. Access lasts at most one hour and retains normal authorization checks.
emergency.review: Retrospective review is required. Critical alert delivery remains subject to its recorded operation status.
emergency.uncertain: The result is unknown. Retry the same request to reconcile it.
emergency.expired: This emergency flow has expired. Start a new admitted flow.

delivery.delivered: The critical alert has an actual delivered receipt.
delivery.degraded: Critical alert delivery is degraded; an incident is recorded and independent retries continue.
delivery.escalated: Critical alert delivery has escalated; independent retries continue.

factorTest.description: Verify this designated administrator's current local emergency factor. This test creates no session or emergency access window.

security.social.denied: This sign-in method is not allowed for this flow.
security.social.invalid: This sign-in could not be verified. Start a fresh flow.
security.social.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait before retrying the same sign-in.
security.journey.samlEmailDescription: Enter the email you want to use to continue this enterprise sign-in. You will review the verified provider before continuing.
security.journey.testCompleted: Provider test completed. You can return to provider administration.
